svg.title: The Judgement Factory — revised miniature composition
svg.desc: Two large AI machines, one continuous multi-level conveyor and three tiny monkey workers. A human-operated lever authorises an output; the other path stays visible.

g.text: THE JUDGEMENT FACTORY / MINIATURE WORKING WORLD
Static storyboard. Workers are 40 units tall in a 1000-unit-wide world. No animation implemented.
